newsitem.title: DENMARK: TENNIS-JOHANSSON WINS HIS FIRST ATP TOUR TITLE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-JOHANSSON WINS HIS FIRST ATP TOUR TITLE.

text.p: Swedish fifth seed Thomas Johansson landed his first ATP Tour title when he beat second-seeded Czech Martin Damn in the Copenhagen Open final on Sunday.
Johansson's speed and superb double-handed backhand proved more than a match for Damn, giving the Swedish player a 6-4 3-6 6-2 win.
The Swede showed signs of pressure only at 4-4 in the first set after serving four double faults. But the moment passed as he broke the Czech's serve, then secured the set.

Johansson remained outwardly calm and impassive as Damn took the second set, and the young Swede raced ahead in the third, building a 5-1 lead which Damn only managed to slim to 5-2 before Johansson wraped up the match.
Johansson displayed powerful and consistent serves and his returns have been among the best in the tournament.
The Swede said: "I don't have any ATP ranking points to defend before Wimbledon, so my goal for this year is to get even higher than the top 50.".
